canada.title: Students in northern Alberta walk out to protest teacher's post about residential schools
canada.summary: Dozens of students walked out of a Grande Prairie high school in mid-October to protest a social media post shared by a teacher in the northern Alberta city.

canada.title: Ontario career college students worry about impact of OSAP pause, extended to 2027
canada.summary: Now that the Ontario government has confirmed that a provincewide pause on student financial assistance payments to career colleges will last for months, some students say they’re worried it will prevent them from graduating.

canada.title: Man killed while changing tire on Deerfoot Trail, police say
canada.summary: A 70-year-old man is dead after being hit by a truck and trailer on Deerfoot Trail on Tuesday afternoon, Calgary police said.

canada.summary: Newspaper of record for Nunavut, and the Nunavik territory of Quebec

canada.title: Some N.L. government sites taken offline due to 'global cybersecurity vulnerability'
canada.summary: The Newfoundland and Labrador provincial government says some of its websites and online services are down because of a "newly disclosed global cybersecurity vulnerability."

canada.title: Hundreds of nurses gather outside Corner Brook city hall to protest with locked out workers
canada.summary: Hundreds of nurses gathered outside Corner Brook’s city hall Wednesday to rally in support of workers locked out of the civic centre. Yvette Coffey, president of the Registered Nurses' Union of N.L. says they’re showing solidarity.

canada.title: No one hurt after downed live wire traps Whitehorse students in nearby school bus
canada.summary: A downed tree knocked over a power line Tuesday outside Selkirk Elementary School in Whitehorse. Students aboard a school bus had to on the bus until emergency responders secured the area.

canada.title: Charges dropped after judge finds Halifax police violated man's Charter rights
canada.summary: Nova Scotia Supreme Court Justice Scott Norton ruled evidence seized from Derrick Allison and his truck was taken in violation of his Charter rights and can't be used against him.

canada.title: Province directs Vitalité to send nurses filling ER vacancies back to primary care
canada.summary: Vitalité Health Network says it still needs help in an understaffed emergency room in northern N.B., despite the province telling it to return nurses it pulled from primary care back to their roles.

canada.title: Fredericton police investigating man's death at homeless encampment
canada.summary: Police in Fredericton are investigating the death of a man found in a homeless encampment on the north side of the city.

canada.title: N.S. NDP removes MLA Paul Wozney as whip after France post
canada.summary: Wozney removed his social media post which read, "Don't leave it to the courts. Learn from France. Own the streets. Shut government down. Grind the province/country to a halt and force government to abandon illegal legislation in the present. It's the **only** direct line to worker justice."

canada.title: New beds added to Saskatoon hospital, full expansion deadline pushed back
canada.summary: The remaining 49 beds are facing delays due to construction at both Market Mall and Saskatoon City Hospital, says Health Minister Jeremy Cockrill

canada.title: Chow, Bradford clash over future of Toronto’s water
canada.summary: The future of Toronto’s water has become a focal point of the mayoral race with less than five days to go before election day.

canada.title: Communities take over Fort St. John airport operations after 30 years of private management
canada.summary: Local communities in northeast B.C. are set to take over operations at Fort St. John's regional airport after 30 years of private management.

canada.title: Sask. premier says province will seek alternatives after cancelling CWD testing program
canada.summary: Premier Scott Moe says the province's plan to pull testing for chronic wasting disease (CWD) in harvested game animals was a budget decision.

canada.title: Winnipeg-based rescue techs parachuted into Wainwright after deadly military base fire
canada.summary: Nearly a dozen search and rescue personnel from Winnipeg were among those deployed to Alberta when a deadly fire engulfed a training exercise at CFB Wainwright on Saturday.

canada.title: New calf born to endangered southern resident orcas in B.C.
canada.summary: Researchers say the male calf was spotted in waters near B.C. twice this week, and is likely less than a week old.

canada.title: Winnipeg mayoral candidates clash over public safety, transit in 680 CJOB debate
canada.summary: Richard Cloutier will host three of Winnipeg's mayoral candidates, incumbent Mayor Scott Gillingham, Kevin Klein and Mike Vogiatzakis, for a debate on 680 CJOB Wednesday morning.
